text: AI agents such as Gemini, ChatGPT, and Copilot can find products, compare options, and make purchases for shoppers
quote: Agentic Commerce enables AI agents like Gemini, ChatGPT, and Copilot to act on behalf of shoppers. For example, AI agents can find products, compare options, and make purchases.

text: Shoppers can complete full transactions without leaving their conversation with the AI agent
quote: shoppers can make complete transactions without leaving the interaction with your AI agent.

text: Agent platforms can tokenize shopper payment credentials with Adyen and get an ACP token that merchants use to process the payment
quote: Adyen stores the credential and returns an ACP token that your agent passes to the merchant. The merchant uses the token to process the payment with Adyen.

text: Adyen issues UCP payment tokens bound to a specific checkout session and merchant identifier
quote: Adyen returns a UCP token that is associated with the specific checkout session and merchant identifier.

text: Adyen manages the full Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) checkout flow for its merchants
quote: Manage the full Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) checkout flow on behalf of Adyen merchants.

text: Adyen manages the full Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) checkout flow for its merchants
quote: Manage the full Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) checkout flow on behalf of Adyen merchants.

text: Adyen orchestrates stock validation, tax calculation, shipping, and payment authorization with merchants during agent checkout
quote: Adyen handles the communication with our merchants and the downstream complexity of orchestrating stock validation, tax calculation, shipping, and payment authorization.

text: Creating a checkout session returns a UCP envelope with totals and fulfillment options
quote: Adyen returns the created session with UCP envelope, totals, and fulfillment options.

text: AI discovery becomes checkout-ready carts, with live pricing, tax, and shipping synced when an item is selected
quote: Convert high intent AI-powered discovery into checkout-ready carts, with live pricing, tax, and shipping synced at the point of selection.

text: Merchants connect to multiple AI agent platforms through one Adyen integration that works with existing order and fulfillment systems
quote: Connect to AI platforms through a single integration that works with your existing order management and fulfillment systems. No rebuild required.

text: Optional cancel-session step releases reserved inventory when a shopper abandons checkout
quote: Cancel session (optional): Release reserved inventory when the shopper abandons checkout.

text: Optional commit-session step runs a final price or stock check before Adyen authorizes payment
quote: Commit session (optional): Run a final price or stock check before Adyen authorizes the payment.

text: Product catalog data is synced to AI platforms like OpenAI and Meta, and one item can target multiple platforms in a single request
quote: The mapped data is synchronized with AI platforms like OpenAI and Meta. A single item can target multiple platforms in one request.

text: A single product feed adapts automatically to each AI platform's requirements, with real-time catalog and inventory data
quote: Deliver a single product feed that automatically adapts to each AI platform's requirements, with accurate, real-time catalog and inventory data.

text: Product data can be uploaded in batches of up to 200 items
quote: You upload product data in batches of up to 200 items.

text: Google Pay payments can be processed through Adyen when Google AI Mode or Gemini agents initiate transactions
quote: Use this integration for processing Google Pay payments through Adyen, when Google agents (Google AI Mode or Gemini) initiate transactions with you.

text: Accept payments across all major agentic commerce protocols and channels
quote: Accept payments across all the major agentic protocols and channels while staying compliant, secure and fully in control.

text: An official MCP server lets users work with Adyen in natural language from their chosen LLM client
quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.

text: Webhooks push status changes for asynchronous processes, so there's no need to poll
quote: With webhooks, you can avoid having to continuously poll an API endpoint, waiting for a change in status for an asynchronous process

text: API definitions are published for use in Swagger Editor or SwaggerHub
quote: If you prefer to use the classic Swagger toolset, upload these definitions to the Swagger Editor or SwaggerHub.

text: The customer approves each payment before it is processed
quote: Customer approves payment. Transactions are screened for fraud and securely processed.

text: Agent-initiated transactions are screened for fraud before processing
quote: Customer approves payment. Transactions are screened for fraud and securely processed.
